Name: Customizable Lighting - Indoor Outdoor Lamps and Street Lights
Author: ZeroXPatch
Description:
[center][b][size=6]Indoor & Outdoor Lighting

[/size][/b][/center][left][list]
[*]Version 1.0.1[list]
[*]Fixed the flickering and strobing light effects that occurred in locations like the Farmhouse and Ginger Island. Thanks 2442784869!
[/list]
[*]Version 1.0[list]
[*]Added a "Night Time Only" option that dynamically adapts to sunset times (compatible with time-changing mods).
[*]Added a "FarmHouse Only" toggle to limit indoor lighting effects strictly to player homes.
[*]Added an "Excluded Locations" text field to prevent specific maps (like the Greenhouse) from being affected.
[*]Fixed an issue where setting Intensity to 0 would cause light sources to disappear permanently.
[*]Verified and corrected the Red and Green color channel mappings.
[*]Optimized performance for Stardew Valley 1.6 by using the new global light source dictionary.
[/list]
[*]Version 0.2Beta[list]
[*]Updated preset; Updated default json for missing keys
[/list]
[*]Version 0.1Beta[list]
[*]Release
[/list]
[/list]
[line]
[size=3]Safe to uninstall anytime. Removing it just disables the features.[/size]

[size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/ZeroXPatch/mods?gameId=1303&sortBy=endorsements]https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/ZeroXPatch/mods?gameId=1303&sortBy=endorsements[/url][/size][/left]
Take control of the atmosphere in Stardew Valley! This mod allows you to customize the color, intensity, and radius of environmental lights (street lamps, windows, sconces) with separate configurations for indoor and outdoor locations.

[size=4]
[/size][size=4][b]Features[/b]
[/size]
[list]
[*][b]Independent Configurations:[/b] Completely separate settings for Indoors and Outdoors. Keep your farmhouse warm and cozy while making the town streets cold and mysterious.
[*][b]Dynamic Night Mode: [/b]Option to enable effects only at night. This features adapts dynamically to the season and other mods (like Dynamic Night Time), activating exactly 2 hours after sunset.
[*][b]Full RGB Control:[/b] Adjust Red, Green, and Blue channels (0-255) to create any color imaginable.
[*][b]Precision Control: [/b]Fine-tune the [i]Radius[/i] (how far light reaches) and [i]Intensity[/i] (how solid the light looks).
[*][b]FarmHouse Only Mode: [/b]Optional setting to limit indoor changes strictly to your home and cabins, leaving other buildings vanilla.
[*][b]Location Exclusions:[/b] Easily exclude specific areas (like the Greenhouse or Cellar) from lighting changes via a simple text list.
[*][b]Safe Filtering:[/b] Intelligently targets environmental lamps only. It will not affect your Glow Ring, held torches, or other gameplay items.
[/list]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/41214/41214-1768269061-164578170.png[/img]﻿
[line]
[size=4][b][color=#ffff00]Important Technical Note
[/color][/b][/size]
[quote]Please be aware of how Stardew Valley handles lighting:
[list]
[*]Street lamps and certain environmental objects often emit [b]two[/b] separate light sources simultaneously: a wide, faint ambient halo and a smaller, brighter "inner" light.
[*][b]This mod controls the INNER light source.[/b]
[*]As a result, if you drastically change the color (e.g., to bright red), you may still see a faint halo of the original color around the edges. This is a limitation of how the game maps are designed.
[/list][/quote][list]
[/list][line]


[size=4][b]Configuration[/b][/size]
Access the settings via the Gear icon on the title screen (GMCM).

* [b]Night Time Only:[/b] If checked, custom lights only turn on after dark (Auto-detects sunset time).
* [b]FarmHouse Only:[/b] (Indoor) Restricts effects to player homes.
* [b]Excluded Locations:[/b] Input location names (e.g., "Greenhouse, Cellar") to ignore them.
* [b]RGB/Intensity/Radius:[/b] Use sliders to find your perfect atmosphere.
